mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies at Badger Prairie County Park tonight with a full moon. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. The temperature will dip to an overnight low of 53 degrees with no rain predicted.

City officials are busy preparing for upcoming meetings. On November 4th at 6:30 PM, the Plan Commission will review developments including the Ardent Glen third addition, site plans for 1979 Milky Way, and various certified survey maps.

It is a busy day for local fun! Today you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market or catch live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness on October 26th or trivia nights starting October 27th.

The Verona Police Department reported an incident from October 15th, where a school bus driver was arrested for O W I. Officers confirmed that alcohol was not a factor, and no students were injured during the event.
Stop by for a scoop of today's flavor, Turtle. We are currently open until our closing time of 10:30 PM, so there is plenty of time to grab a treat this evening.
